facts.name: sidebar min width
facts.cite: ContextualMenuActions.BF8iy9S9.js - X2=192, in the sidebar constant cluster. Dereferenced: w=Math.max(X2,Math.min(titleBarClusterWidth,330)) -> T=Math.max(store.sidebarWidth,w) -> re=l?330:T -> width:de, de=Rg(re). Floor of the left nav width; collapse threshold is X2/4. TIER: minified local, not a named key — the identifier (X2/xtn) justifies nothing by itself, so this rests entirely on the dereference chain above. Weaker than a named-constant citation; not consumed by style.css.ts yet.
